slides.texte_overlay:
what i stopped doing to
finally feel confident

asking for permission

i stopped asking is it okay if i before every small request. people respond to clear asks, and dropping the permission habit finally made me feel like a real adult.

replaying conversations

i stopped replaying every conversation in bed at night. most people forget what you said within minutes, and finally letting it go gave me back hours of sleep.

hiding my opinions

i stopped saying i don't mind when i actually did. small honest opinions shared every day slowly turned into the confidence to speak up when it really mattered.

feeling behind

i stopped feeling behind by learning something small every day: a moment in history, a painting, a planet. five minutes of growth a day quietly fixed my sense of being left out.
slides.texte_sophia:
feeling behind

i stopped feeling behind by learning something small every day. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and five minutes of growth quietly fixed that feeling.

slides.texte_overlay:
waiting to be ready

i stopped waiting to feel ready before i tried things. readiness never came first, it only ever showed up after i'd already started, stumbled and survived it.
